Full job description
**Federal Project - Applicant must be a United States Citizen with Active Secret Clearance**

Baer is looking for SAP UiPath Test Automation Developer for a 4+ month Federal remote project.

Title: SAP UiPath Test Automation Developer
Location: Remote (Must be based in US)
Duration: 4 months
Rate: All-inclusive
Alignment: W2 or C2C

Overview:

The SAP UiPath Test Automation Developer will design, develop, execute, and maintain automated testing solutions using UiPath for SAP S/4HANA and integrated applications. The role will support integration, regression, smoke, negative, and end-to-end testing while improving test coverage and accelerating repeatable testing.

Description:
Develop reusable and parameterized UiPath automation workflows from approved test cases, business processes, and acceptance criteria.
Automate testing across SAP GUI, SAP Fiori, web applications, interfaces, and integrated systems.
Configure test data, variables, checkpoints, exception handling, logging, and evidence capture.
Execute automated test suites and analyze test failures to identify application versus automation defects.
Maintain and update automation scripts based on SAP configuration, process, and release changes.
Document test results and defects and maintain traceability in the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
Collaborate with functional and technical testers, government stakeholders, system integrators, and UAT teams to identify automation opportunities.
Support UiPath Orchestrator execution, monitoring, troubleshooting, demonstrations, and automation documentation.
Support regression testing, release readiness, production-readiness assessments, and knowledge transfer.

Requirement:
Hands-on experience developing test automation using UiPath.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP GUI, and SAP Fiori testing.
Experience automating integration, regression, smoke, negative, and end-to-end tests.
Strong understanding of test automation frameworks, reusable workflows, test data, exception handling, and logging.
Experience with UiPath Orchestrator is preferred.
Experience with defect tracking, test documentation, RTM, and test reporting.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments is preferred.
Active DoD Secret clearance required.

Company Overview:

Baer provides best-in-class engagement experiences for our consultants. Our job requirements are carefully vetted and are typically associated with pivotal programs offering tremendous opportunities to expand your skills leveraging the latest solutions.

Baer is an equal opportunity employer including disability/veteran.
